steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each open case is placed by its age from the day it was opened.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 case is older than its priority target

findings.title: Case older than its priority target
Case with no update for three working days

outcome.notChecked: Cases not in the export; the quality of the resolution.

pros: Checks a case older than its priority target, a case with no owner, and a case with no update for three working days.
cons: Not checked: Cases not in the export; the quality of the resolution.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-cs-daily-backlog skill on the records for this review.
